isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Seychelles lexicon here. Seychellois is a separate dataset under this folder. Do not copy Mauritian or Réunion Creole.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named language folder under data/seychelles_dataset/. A merged Seychelles lexicon is not stored at this path.
